answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake collateral tied to a single verified identity, so an attacker cannot forge thousands of cheap copies without paying for each one. Honest work over time builds a reputation signal that acts like a prism: it splits one real history into verifiable proofs across tasks, while fresh fake identities start dim, with no track record, no stake at risk, and no trusted endorsements, making large-scale fakery expensive and easy to spot.
